definitions.explanation: Having a shape that is narrow in width relative to its length. Describes objects, shapes, or body parts that are stretched out and slim.

examples.japanese: {細長|ほそなが}い{廊下|ろうか}が{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: A long, narrow corridor stretches ahead.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{細長|ほそなが}い{指|ゆび}をしている。
{日本|にほん}は{細長|ほそなが}い{島国|しまぐに}だ。
examples.english: Japan is a long, narrow island nation.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{細長|ほそなが}い → {細長|ほそなが}くない (negative)
・{細長|ほそなが}い → {細長|ほそなが}く (adverbial form)
・{細長|ほそなが}い → {細長|ほそなが}かった (past)

FORMATION:
Compound adjective formed from {細|ほそ}い (thin) + {長|なが}い (long).

USAGE:
Describes objects, spaces, or body parts that are notably elongated and slim.
・{細長|ほそなが}い{形|かたち} (elongated shape)
・{細長|ほそなが}い{顔|かお} (long, narrow face)
・{細長|ほそなが}い{建物|たてもの} (long, narrow building)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{長細|ながぼそ}い - Same meaning, less common variant
・{細|ほそ}い - Just thin/narrow, without the length component
